SPECIFICATION & FORMULA

Calculation Methodology

Total Clicks = Subscribers × CTR%. Conversions = Clicks × Conv%. Net Revenue = Conversions × Profit per Sale.

REFERENCE BASIS: Standard Industry Financial & Technical Formula • ASSUMPTIONS VERIFIED: October 2026

Reference Notes & FAQ

What is a realistic Click-to-Conversion rate for targeted email lists?

Warm newsletter subscribers typically convert at 2% to 5% on relevant digital products or SaaS offers.

How is Email Revenue Per Subscriber (RPS) calculated?

Divide monthly email-attributed net revenue by your total active subscriber count.
